# Anne & Janet

- [Anne](../character/anne.md) — Friend of — [Janet](../character/janet.md) — friendly confiding acquaintance and neighbour at Redmond · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Last P45](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0045)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) arrives at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) station and gets a ride to her boarding house with Mrs. Amelia [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), who is filling in on the mail route for her new husband. During the drive, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) entertains [Anne](../character/anne.md) with stories about choosing true love over wealth and warns her about local geography before dropping her off at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXX Mrs. Skinner’s Romance

> [Janet](../character/janet.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne.md) to a prayer meeting in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), where they meet [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), who walks [Janet](../character/janet.md) home. Later, John invites [Janet](../character/janet.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) to his house for tea to meet his mother, who acts excessively sweet and fragile while subtly making [Janet](../character/janet.md) uncomfortable. [Anne](../character/anne.md) notices John's pained expression during the visit and wonders about the true dynamic in his household as they return to [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Douglas

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to find [Janet](../character/janet.md) crying on her fortieth birthday because [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) has been visiting her for twenty years without proposing. Encouraged by [Anne](../character/anne.md) to stand up for herself, [Janet](../character/janet.md) coldly rejects John's offer to walk her home after a prayer meeting. However, seeing John's hurt reaction, [Anne](../character/anne.md) immediately regrets her advice and runs after him to bring him back to [Janet](../character/janet.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIII “He Just Kept Coming and Coming”

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives an awkward proposal from [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she politely rejects and later laughs about with [Janet](../character/janet.md). Shortly after, [Alec](../character/alec.md) arrives to announce that John Douglas's mother is dying, and she passes away soon after. Following the funeral, [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) comes to [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) and proposes to [Janet](../character/janet.md), explaining that his late mother had forced him to swear a secret oath not to marry while she was alive.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIV John Douglas Speaks at Last
